description.value: Bean Around the World is a specialty coffee roaster with over 30 years of operation, hand-roasting small batches daily at its North Vancouver roastery headquarters. The brand operates physical cafe locations in the region and sells beans, brew gear, and accessories online. A touring cyclist stopping in would find a quality coffee stop with a long local heritage.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a cafe in Vancouver with coordinates placing it in south/central Vancouver (49.245°N, 123.127°W). The website confirms Bean Around the World is a real, active coffee roaster, but its stated address is 1462 Columbia Street, North Vancouver, BC V7J 1A2 — which is geographically inconsistent with the OSM coordinates. The website is primarily an e-commerce roastery storefront; it references physical 'Locations' but the fetched content does not include that page, so no in-store amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) could be confirmed.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM places the node in Vancouver (no street address provided), but the website's sole listed address is 1462 Columbia Street, North Vancouver, BC V7J 1A2. The OSM coordinates are not consistent with that North Vancouver address.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM coordinates (49.245°N, 123.127°W) place this cafe in Vancouver proper, but the business's own website lists its only address as 1462 Columbia Street, North Vancouver — a different municipality several kilometres away. This could be a separate franchise/retail cafe location not listed on the website, or an OSM geocoding error; the Locations page content was not fetched so it cannot be resolved from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website phone number 1-888-294-1111 was not present in the OSM record and has been added from the website. To resolve the location discrepancy, the Locations page (batwcoffee.com/pages/locations or similar) should be reviewed to determine whether a Vancouver (non-North Vancouver) branch exists at or near the OSM coordinates.
